title: A request through an Application Load Balancer
claim: Each request reaches a load balancer node in one zone, and the node sends it to a healthy target.
alt: An architecture with users on the left and an Application Load Balancer with a node in each of two Availability Zones. Each zone has one instance in a private subnet; the instance in the second zone is marked unhealthy. Numbered arrows run from the users to a node and on to the healthy instance.

edges.label: name lookup
edges.say: The client resolves the DNS name and gets the IP addresses of the load balancer nodes.

edges.label: listener
edges.say: The client connects to a node, whose listener is configured with a protocol and port number.

edges.label: rules
edges.say: The node evaluates the listener rules in priority order to choose a target group.

edges.label: private IP
edges.say: The node selects a healthy registered target and sends the request to its private IP address.

edges.label: no requests
edges.say: As long as other targets are healthy, a failed target gets no new requests until the load balancer resumes routing traffic to that target.
